summary: Standardize reuse, redup, benchmarks and overview in default workstreams, and support configurable delivery profile maxActiveMinutes for XS.

delivery.outcome: Standardize manifest.default.json workstreams with .reuse/**, .redup/**, .benchmarks/** in governance and OVERVIEW.md in integration; make delivery profile maxActiveMinutes configurable for XS class without hardcoded 10 minute ceiling.
nonGoals: No removal of default 10-minute fallback when maxActiveMinutes is omitted for XS
No changes to external gate policies

architecture.decision: Add standard tool and documentation paths to default manifest workstreams and read profile maxActiveMinutes before falling back to default 10 for XS.

commands: python3 -c "import json; m=json.load(open('governance/manifest.default.json')); assert '.reuse/**' in m['coordination']['workstreams']['governance']['ownedPaths'] and 'OVERVIEW.md' in m['coordination']['workstreams']['integration']['ownedPaths']"
validation.evidence: Manifest default registers standard tool and doc paths.

commands: python3 -c "from scripts.governance_check import effective_delivery_policy; p={'maxActiveMinutes': 120, 'profiles': {'XS': {'maxActiveMinutes': 25}}}; lim=effective_delivery_policy(p, 'XS'); assert lim.get('maxActiveMinutes') == 25"
validation.evidence: Delivery budget check supports configured profile maxActiveMinutes.
Governance check passes with zero errors.
